title: Ram's Young Desert-Testing Crew Logs Sand Dune Data — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Ram's Young Desert-Testing Crew Logs Sand Dune Data
A team in the UAE records how heavy-duty trucks perform in extreme heat and soft sand.
Ram has embedded a young desert-testing crew in the UAE to collect data on heavy-duty pickup behaviour in soft sand and extreme heat. The team, led by 25-year-old Omar Al-Farsi, runs instrumented trucks through dune fields outside Abu Dhabi.
Sensors record powertrain cooling, tyre pressure changes and traction-control intervention. Al-Farsi said the data is fed back to engineers in Auburn Hills, who adjust calibration for Middle Eastern markets.
The programme is one of several regional hot-climate validation efforts. It also gives Ram a local story to tell customers in Gulf states, where full-size trucks are popular among younger buyers.

title: Fiat Panda Returns to South Africa With Localised Marketing — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Fiat Panda Returns to South Africa With Localised Marketing
The compact hatchback is back in the market after a brief absence, targeting first-time buyers.
Fiat has reintroduced the Panda to South Africa after a brief absence, using a marketing campaign aimed at young first-time buyers. Nia Okafor, a 34-year-old brand manager based in Johannesburg, said the car's compact footprint and low running costs match local urban needs.
The launch edition is priced below the segment average and includes a fixed-service plan. Okafor added that the campaign will focus on social media and partnerships rather than traditional television advertising.
Dealers in Cape Town and Durban have taken initial stock. Fiat is using South Africa as a test case for a similar strategy in other African markets.

title: Stellantis Named Among Top Ten Global Employers for Engineering Graduates — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis Named Among Top Ten Global Employers for Engineering Graduates
A European business-school survey ranks the group highly for battery research and software academies.
By Owen DelacroixMaleNorth America44-59positive
Stellantis ranked in the top ten of a global survey of engineering graduates, cited for its battery research, software academies and rotational programmes across Turin, Detroit and Auburn Hills. The ranking was compiled by a leading European business school.
Recruiters said the result reflects the company's push to hire talent for its STLA platforms and autonomous-driving partnerships. The recognition is particularly notable given a broader industry talent war.
Stellantis plans to add 2,000 engineering roles this year, concentrated in electrification, embedded systems and manufacturing software.

title: Opel, Corsa Electric'in Türkiye Fiyatlarını Açıkladı — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Opel, Corsa Electric'in Türkiye Fiyatlarını Açıkladı
Yenilenen batarya paketi menzili artırırken giriş fiyatı beklenenin altında kaldı.
By Deniz KaracaMaleEurope28-43positive
Opel, yenilenen Corsa Electric modelinin Türkiye fiyatlarını açıkladı. Daha yüksek yoğunluklu batarya paketi sayesinde WLTP menzili 409 kilometreye çıkarken, giriş seviyesi fiyat sektör beklentilerinin altında konumlandı.
Şirket, ilk teslimatların eylül ayında başlayacağını ve yetkili servis ağının hızlı şarj altyapısıyla birlikte genişletileceğini belirtti.

title: Stellantis Electric Sales in Europe Rebound as Incentives Return — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis Electric Sales in Europe Rebound as Incentives Return
Registrations for Stellantis battery models climbed in July as several European markets reinstated purchase grants.
Stellantis battery-electric registrations in the European Union rose sharply in July, according to figures reported by Reuters, as France and Spain restored consumer purchase grants. Peugeot e-208 and Citroen e-C3 accounted for most of the gain.
Helena Brandt, an employed full-time business correspondent based in Frankfurt, notes the rebound narrows the gap with rivals after a weak spring. Executives said order books for September are the strongest in eighteen months.

title: Dodge Hornet R/T PHEV Wins Midwest Automotive Media Association Value Award — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Dodge Hornet R/T PHEV Wins Midwest Automotive Media Association Value Award
Judges praise the compact plug-in hybrid's powertrain and price positioning against premium rivals.
By Renata SokolFemaleEurope28-43positive
Dodge's Hornet R/T plug-in hybrid received the Midwest Automotive Media Association's value award in the compact performance category. Judges praised its powertrain output and price positioning against premium-badged rivals.
The award arrives as Dodge seeks to broaden its audience beyond traditional muscle-car buyers. The Hornet R/T uses a turbocharged four-cylinder paired with an electric motor for a combined 288 horsepower.
Dodge said the recognition will inform marketing for the 2027 model year, when the Hornet line gains a mild-hybrid base option and a larger touchscreen.

title: Fiat Recalls Panda and 500 Models Over Brake Servo Concerns — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Fiat Recalls Panda and 500 Models Over Brake Servo Concerns
Roughly 120,000 small cars in Europe are called back for a corroding brake component.
By Giulia PanettaFemaleEurope44-59negative
Fiat is recalling approximately 120,000 Panda and 500 models in Europe over a brake servo component that may corrode in high-humidity regions. The recall covers vehicles built between 2019 and 2024.
Regulators in Italy and Germany opened files after a small number of owners reported increased pedal effort. Fiat said no accidents or injuries have been linked to the issue and that repairs will take under two hours.
The recall adds to a difficult run for Fiat's small-car business, which has already adjusted 500e production twice this year. Dealers expect replacement parts to be available next month.

title: Citroën C5 Aircross Sales Miss Target in Key European Markets — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Citroën C5 Aircross Sales Miss Target in Key European Markets
The mid-size SUV fell 18 percent short of its first-half plan in France, Germany and Italy.
By Thibault RenardMaleEurope44-59negative
Citroën's C5 Aircross fell short of its first-half sales target in France, Germany and Italy, missing the plan by roughly 18 percent. The mid-size SUV faces renewed competition from Korean and Chinese brands in the same price band.
Dealers cited a dated interior and the absence of a full battery option until next year as the main weaknesses. Citroën has responded with larger incentives and a temporary extension of warranty coverage.
An updated C5 Aircross with a full electric drivetrain is due in 2027. Until then, the brand is relying on the smaller ë-C3 to carry its electrification volume.

title: Alfa Romeo Mexico Giulia Touring Club Struggles to Gain Traction — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Alfa Romeo Mexico Giulia Touring Club Struggles to Gain Traction
The enthusiast club is a low-cost experiment to rebuild a brand that has faded in Latin America.
Alfa Romeo Mexico launched a local Giulia Touring Club aimed at younger owners of the Italian sedan and its classic predecessors. The first event drew a small group of drivers from Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey for a modest track day at the national circuit.
Organisers also hosted restoration workshops, but attendance was lower than hoped. Camila Herrera, the 24-year-old club coordinator, said the goal is to keep the brand relevant to a new generation, even though Alfa Romeo has not sold a new sedan in Mexico for several years.
The club is supported by a small parts grant from the local importer. Alfa Romeo sees the community as a low-cost way to rebuild its presence in Latin America, where its sales have fallen to a fraction of their previous level.

title: Chrysler Pacifica Retiree Owners Share Two-Decade Loyalty Stories — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Chrysler Pacifica Retiree Owners Share Two-Decade Loyalty Stories
Long-term owners in Michigan reflect on the minivan's evolution from Town & Country to plug-in.
Chrysler gathered a group of long-term owners near Detroit to mark the Pacifica's heritage line, tracing its roots from the Town & Country to the current plug-in hybrid. Among them was Robert D. Chen, a 71-year-old retired engineer who has owned three Chrysler minivans.
Chen praised the sliding doors and flat load floor as practical features that remained constant across generations. He also noted the shift from V6 to hybrid, saying his Pacifica plug-in now handles most daily errands without using petrol.
The event is part of Chrysler's effort to highlight loyalty among its older customer base while it prepares a larger product transition. Chrysler now sells only the Pacifica and a fleet-only Voyager.

title: Jeep Wrangler Owners in Japan Build a Tight Trail Community — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Jeep Wrangler Owners in Japan Build a Tight Trail Community
A group of off-road enthusiasts in the Kansai region is mapping remote mountain routes.
Jeep Wrangler owners in Japan's Kansai region have formed a trail-mapping community, sharing GPS routes and maintenance tips for remote mountain tracks. Yuki Tanaka, a 51-year-old member, coordinates monthly drives in the Mie and Nara prefectures.
The group has mapped more than forty trails, noting water crossings, recovery points and seasonal closures. Tanaka said the Wrangler's aftermarket support in Japan has improved, making it easier to source lift kits and all-terrain tyres.
Jeep's local importer has noticed the activity and is considering a small sponsorship for the group's safety events. The community is mostly independent and self-funded.

title: Peugeot Design Studio Confronts Cramped EV Cabin Constraints — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Peugeot Design Studio Confronts Cramped EV Cabin Constraints
A studio in Amsterdam explores how compact EV cabins can feel roomier without stretching the body.
Peugeot's new urban design studio in Amsterdam is studying how to make small electric car interiors feel more spacious. The work focuses on seating position, glass area and storage without lengthening the vehicle body.
Jules De Vries, 32, leads the studio's interior perception group. They said current small EVs often feel cramped because battery packaging raises the floor, and Peugeot is trying to counter that with thinner seat structures and more vertical glass.
The first concepts are expected to feed into the next generation of the 208 and e-2008. However, analysts note that fixing the packaging problem will raise costs in a segment where margins are already thin.

title: Stellantis Q2 Earnings: Margins Compress as North American Inventory Clears — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis Q2 Earnings: Margins Compress as North American Inventory Clears
Adjusted operating income falls year on year while European share holds steady.
By Owen DelacroixMaleNorth America44-59negative
Stellantis reported second-quarter adjusted operating income of €5.1 billion, down year on year, as North American destocking and incentives weighed on margins. Net revenues came in at €41.8 billion.
Europe was a relative bright spot, with share roughly flat and electrified sales growing in the high single digits. The company reaffirmed full-year guidance for a double-digit adjusted operating margin and positive industrial free cash flow.
Shares moved modestly lower in Milan. A more detailed mid-decade product plan is scheduled for an investor day later in the year.

title: DS N°8 Reveal Highlights 466-Mile Range, But Limited Market Reach — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
DS N°8 Reveal Highlights 466-Mile Range, But Limited Market Reach
The flagship fastback offers impressive range, yet the brand remains a small-volume player in Europe.
DS Automobiles revealed the N°8 flagship fastback EV with a claimed WLTP range of 466 miles. It sits on an extended STLA Medium architecture and will be built at Mulhouse in France.
Three variants are planned: front-drive long-range, a smaller-pack mid-level version, and a 350hp dual-motor all-wheel-drive model. The interior features upgraded materials and a faster infotainment system.
Order books open in France in October, with wider European availability early next year. DS remains a small-volume brand concentrated in France and neighbouring markets, raising questions about whether the investment will move the needle for Stellantis' premium ambitions.

title: Alfa Romeo Giulia Successor Reverses All-Electric Pledge — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Alfa Romeo Giulia Successor Reverses All-Electric Pledge
The brand will offer a combustion option in markets where EV demand is weak, disappointing some long-time followers.
Alfa Romeo teased its Giulia successor with a single image confirming a twin-motor electric layout and rear torque bias. A full reveal is set for early next year, with production at Cassino in Italy.
The car will use the STLA Large architecture. Alfa engineers have independent latitude to tune suspension and steering ratios. However, the brand confirmed a combustion option in markets where electric demand is weak, reversing an earlier all-electric commitment that had been central to its marketing message.
Pricing is expected to sit slightly above the outgoing Giulia. A high-performance Quadrifoglio variant is expected roughly a year after launch, but the reversal has drawn criticism from environmental groups and some brand loyalists.

title: فيات 500 الهجينة تسجّل طلبًا قويًا في أسواق الخليج — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
فيات 500 الهجينة تسجّل طلبًا قويًا في أسواق الخليج
المدينية الصغيرة تعود إلى الواجهة بفضل استهلاك منخفض وأسعار تنافسية.
By ليان الحمصيFemaleMiddle East28-43positive
سجّلت فيات 500 الهجينة طلبًا يفوق التوقعات في أسواق الخليج، بعد إطلاقها بسعر تنافسي ومعدل استهلاك منخفض يناسب القيادة داخل المدن المزدحمة.
وقالت الشركة إن حصص التوزيع للربع القادم نفدت في بعض الأسواق، وإن مصنع ميرافيوري في إيطاليا يعمل على زيادة الإنتاج لتلبية الطلب.

title: Stellantis CEO Says Tariff Regime Is Reshaping North American Sourcing — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis CEO Says Tariff Regime Is Reshaping North American Sourcing
Leadership signals a multi-year shift in component supply as duties reshape landed costs.
Stellantis' CEO said the North American tariff regime has forced a structural rethink of component sourcing, calling it a multi-year programme. The company has already relocated sourcing for several high-value subsystems and is evaluating electrical architecture and seating.
The comments reflect a broader industry recalculation as duties alter landed-cost maths. Stellantis has been working with suppliers to increase qualifying regional content on its platforms.
The company declined to quantify the total cost, saying it is reflected in the capital plan. Union representatives cautioned that relocated sourcing does not automatically create domestic assembly jobs.

title: بيجو توسّع التجميع المحلي في مصر لطراز 3008 — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
بيجو توسّع التجميع المحلي في مصر لطراز 3008
خط إنتاج جديد قرب القاهرة يرفع نسبة المكوّن المحلي ويخفض تكلفة الطراز في السوق المصرية.
By كريم عبد الرحمنMaleMiddle East28-43positive
وسّعت بيجو عمليات التجميع المحلي في مصر لتشمل طراز 3008، عبر خط إنتاج جديد قرب القاهرة يرفع نسبة المكوّن المحلي إلى نحو 45 بالمئة، ما يخفّض السعر النهائي للمستهلك.
وأكدت ستيلانتيس أن الخطوة تأتي ضمن استراتيجية توطين الإنتاج في شمال أفريقيا، مع توقعات بتصدير جزء من الإنتاج إلى أسواق مجاورة خلال العام المقبل.

title: Citroën Takes ë-C3 Budget EV Into Four New European Markets — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Citroën Takes ë-C3 Budget EV Into Four New European Markets
Poland, Czechia, Portugal and Greece join the rollout as the brand targets first-time electric buyers.
By Thibault RenardMaleEurope44-59positive
Citroën is expanding ë-C3 sales into Poland, Czechia, Portugal and Greece, where electric penetration is below the European average. The budget hatchback is built in Trnava, Slovakia.
The entry car undercuts most rivals while offering a usable real-world range of roughly 180 miles. Citroën is using fixed transparent pricing and a leasing bundle that includes home-charging installation.
Supply is expected to be the main constraint. A slightly larger derivative on the same platform is scheduled to follow, targeting small families who remain price-sensitive.

title: Stellantis Expands Kenitra Output as North African Exports Grow — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis Expands Kenitra Output as North African Exports Grow
The Moroccan plant will add a second shift to serve growing demand for small cars across Europe and Africa.
By Salma Ait BellaFemaleMiddle East & Africa18-27positiveEmployed part-time — student journalistSource: AFP
Stellantis will add a second shift at its Kenitra plant in Morocco, according to AFP, lifting annual capacity as exports of small cars to Europe and West Africa increase. Local sourcing has passed sixty percent of parts by value.
Salma Ait Bella, a part-time employed student journalist covering industry in Rabat, said the expansion is expected to create roughly one thousand direct jobs. Officials framed the move as proof of Morocco's growing role in the group's low-cost network.

title: جيب تطلق واغونير S الكهربائية في أسواق الشرق الأوسط — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
جيب تطلق واغونير S الكهربائية في أسواق الشرق الأوسط
الطراز الكهربائي الرائد يصل إلى الإمارات والسعودية مع بطارية معدّلة لتحمّل الحرارة المرتفعة.
By ليان الحمصيFemaleMiddle East28-43positive
أعلنت جيب عن إطلاق سيارتها الكهربائية الرائدة واغونير S في الإمارات والسعودية، مع نظام تبريد معدّل للبطارية يتحمّل درجات الحرارة المرتفعة في المنطقة. وتبلغ القوة القصوى 600 حصان مع مدى يقارب 480 كيلومترًا.
وقالت الشركة إن الوكلاء في دبي والرياض بدأوا استقبال الطلبات، على أن تصل أولى الوحدات في الربع الأخير من العام. كما سيتم توسيع شبكة الشحن السريع بالتعاون مع شركاء محليين.

title: Stellantis and Union Negotiators Extend Talks Over Plant Staffing Commitments — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis and Union Negotiators Extend Talks Over Plant Staffing Commitments
Both sides report progress on wage structure while job-security language remains unresolved.
Stellantis and union negotiators extended talks past a deadline, with progress on wage structure but job-security language remaining unresolved. The dispute covers minimum staffing at three North American plants and treatment of workers displaced by powertrain transitions.
A union spokesperson said the tone was constructive, while Stellantis said it wants an agreement protecting competitiveness and livelihoods. Separately, the union raised concerns about retraining programmes running below plan at two facilities.
Negotiators set a revised target for the end of next month. Neither side indicated industrial action is imminent, but the missed deadline adds uncertainty ahead of the autumn production schedule.

title: Stellantis Bursa Kapasite Artışında Üretim Kaygıları Gündeme Geldi — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis Bursa Kapasite Artışında Üretim Kaygıları Gündeme Geldi
Hafif ticari araç hattına yapılan yatırım, yan sanayi ve iş güvencesi tartışmalarını da beraberinde getirdi.
By Emre YıldırımMaleEurope28-43negative
Stellantis, Bursa'daki hafif ticari araç üretim hattına yeni bir yatırım yaparak yıllık kapasiteyi yüzde 15 artıracağını duyurdu. Yatırımın büyük bölümü gövde atölyesi ve otomasyon sistemlerine ayrılacak.
Ancak tedarikçiler, yeni otomasyon düzenlemelerinin bazı küçük yan sanayi işletmelerini dışlayabileceğini ve sendika temsilcileri, iş güvencesi taahhütlerinin henüz netleşmediğini belirtti. Şirket, yaklaşık 700 yeni istihdam yaratılacağını açıkladı.

title: Stellantis Extends Midwest Plant Downtime, Idling Thousands of Workers — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis Extends Midwest Plant Downtime, Idling Thousands of Workers
The carmaker widened temporary shutdowns at two US assembly plants, citing slow inventory turnover.
By Darryl SimmonsMaleNorth America44-59negativeUnemployed — former line worker, parent of twoSource: AP News
Stellantis extended downtime at two Midwest assembly plants into September, a move reported by AP News that idles several thousand hourly workers. The company pointed to slow inventory turnover on large SUVs and pickups.
Darryl Simmons, an unemployed former line worker and parent of two who now writes about plant communities, said local suppliers expect knock-on cuts. Union representatives criticised the pace of communication from management.

title: Wrangler 4xe Logs Best U.S. Sales Month Since Launch — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Wrangler 4xe Logs Best U.S. Sales Month Since Launch
Deliveries of the plug-in hybrid Wrangler rose 34 percent year over year in July.
Jeep's Wrangler 4xe plug-in hybrid recorded its strongest U.S. sales month since launch, with deliveries up 34 percent year over year in July. Dealers in the West and Northeast cited improved availability and federal tax credit eligibility as key drivers.
The 4xe now accounts for nearly one in four Wranglers sold domestically, a higher mix than most rivals achieve with their plug-in offerings. Jeep said it is increasing allocation to coastal markets where charging infrastructure is densest.
The result is a rare bright spot for Jeep's electrified portfolio and eases pressure ahead of the Wagoneer S ramp. A refreshed Wrangler is expected to arrive as a 2027 model.

title: Opel Corsa Electric Refresh Brings Range Gains, But UK Mandate Pressure Grows — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Opel Corsa Electric Refresh Brings Range Gains, But UK Mandate Pressure Grows
A revised pack lifts range past 250 miles while Vauxhall's zero-emission sales target looms large.
Opel and Vauxhall refreshed the Corsa Electric, fitting a higher-density battery pack that lifts claimed range to 254 miles. Visually, changes are restrained: a revised front fascia, new wheels and two extra paint options. The interior regains a physical climate control panel after customer feedback.
The Corsa is built at Zaragoza in Spain. Order books opened this month across Europe, with first deliveries in September. However, Vauxhall's UK position is complicated by the zero-emission vehicle mandate, which requires escalating electric share and may force heavier discounting later in the year.
Dealers said the improved range helps, but Corsa Electric still faces cheaper Chinese and Korean rivals in the same segment. Vauxhall has not said whether it will lower prices further to meet the mandate.

title: Dodge Charger Daytona Output Ramp Remains Constrained by Module Supply — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Dodge Charger Daytona Output Ramp Remains Constrained by Module Supply
Windsor assembly adds a second shift, but battery module bottlenecks and exhaust revisions linger.
Dodge added a second shift at Windsor for the Charger Daytona after months of constrained battery module supply. The bottleneck eased in June, but the plant is still building below planned throughput and has revised the car's synthesised Fratzonic exhaust twice after owner complaints about low-speed volume.
Unfilled two-door orders should clear by late autumn, with four-doors following shortly. The combustion inline-six variant is scheduled later in the model year, giving some buyers a reason to wait rather than accept the current electric version.
The ramp is a modest improvement for Stellantis' North American utilisation, which has lagged internal targets since launch. Dealers said the delays have cooled initial enthusiasm for the nameplate's return.

title: Chrysler Pacifica Plug-In Hybrid Posts Best Quarter in Four Years — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Chrysler Pacifica Plug-In Hybrid Posts Best Quarter in Four Years
The minivan's electrified variant now accounts for nearly a third of Pacifica retail volume.
Chrysler's Pacifica plug-in hybrid recorded its strongest quarter since 2022, with the electrified variant accounting for 31 percent of retail deliveries. The brand cited revised incentives, improved hybrid availability and renewed fleet interest from low-emission zones.
The Pacifica is the smallest Stellantis brand by nameplate count, selling only the Pacifica and a shrinking Voyager fleet variant. "Every point of hybrid mix improves the plant economics and the fleet-average numbers," said marketing director Helena Marsh.
The hybrid is built at Windsor alongside the Charger Daytona. A refreshed Pacifica is understood to be in development for the 2028 model year with a larger battery and revised interior.

title: Ram Details 2026 Heavy-Duty Refresh With Higher Tow Ratings — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Ram Details 2026 Heavy-Duty Refresh With Higher Tow Ratings
Revised cooling and a strengthened frame push maximum fifth-wheel towing past 37,000 pounds.
Ram has revealed its refreshed 2026 heavy-duty pickup range, with a maximum fifth-wheel tow rating of 37,200 pounds on the dual-rear-wheel 3500. The gain comes from frame reinforcement, a larger transmission cooler and revised axle hardware rather than more power.
The high-output diesel carries over at 1,075 lb-ft. Inside, the trucks get a reworked cluster and a trailer-management interface with up to 20 stored profiles. Ram also simplified upfit provisions with a new power-distribution module behind the rear seat.
Production begins at Saltillo in October. The refresh arrives as full-size pickup demand softens, but Ram said average transaction prices have held roughly flat.

title: Jeep Adds Trailhawk-Inspired Wagoneer S EV Variant to 2026 Lineup — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Jeep Adds Trailhawk-Inspired Wagoneer S EV Variant to 2026 Lineup
The new off-road-leaning trim brings raised suspension and all-terrain tyres to Jeep's flagship electric SUV.
Jeep expanded its electric flagship with a Wagoneer S variant aimed at off-road buyers. Announced near Moab, the trim adds a 25mm lift, skid plates and all-terrain tyres to the dual-motor platform. Range drops to about 285 miles, while peak output stays at 600 horsepower with retuned torque for crawling.
"We heard Wagoneer intenders wanted a real Jeep when the pavement ends," said Dana Whitlock, Jeep's North American product lead. The variant will be built at Toluca in Mexico, with deliveries starting in the fourth quarter. Pricing has not been finalised, though the premium is expected to be modest.
Dealers in mountain states anticipate strong demand. The launch comes as Jeep works to stabilise its electric lineup after a slower-than-expected ramp for its first battery models.

title: Maserati GranTurismo Folgore Deliveries Slip Again on Software Validation — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Maserati GranTurismo Folgore Deliveries Slip Again on Software Validation
Customers in Europe face a further eight-week wait as the brand re-certifies its battery management software.
By Giulia PanettaFemaleEurope44-59negative
Maserati pushed back European deliveries of the electric GranTurismo Folgore by a further eight weeks to recalibrate battery management software under sustained high-load driving. This is the third delay for the model.
Affected customers get loan vehicles and compensation, with impacted orders in the low hundreds. The Folgore is the electric halo for a brand under pressure, with global volumes falling sharply over two years.
The Modena plant continues to build combustion variants without interruption. Maserati is due to present a revised product plan to Stellantis leadership before year-end.

title: Fiat 500e Registrations Climb in Italy but Slip Across Northern Europe — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Fiat 500e Registrations Climb in Italy but Slip Across Northern Europe
Domestic incentives lift the city car at home while German and Dutch demand softens.
Fiat's 500e posted a 22 percent increase in Italian registrations during the second quarter, helped by national purchase incentives that favour small, domestically assembled EVs. The picture elsewhere was weaker: registrations fell 14 percent in Germany and 9 percent in the Netherlands.
Production at Mirafiori has been adjusted to match demand, with temporary stoppages over the past eighteen months. Fiat is preparing a hybrid 500 on the same line, with first units expected before year-end.
"We built a very good electric city car, and the market for it in Europe turned out smaller than forecast," said analyst Marco Ienna. Fiat's broader European share has been supported by the Panda small crossover.

title: Stellantis Commits €2.4 Billion to Second European Battery Gigafactory Phase — Stellantis Brands Wire
author: Stellantis Brands Wire
text:
Stellantis Commits €2.4 Billion to Second European Battery Gigafactory Phase
The expansion adds 20 gigawatt-hours of annual cell capacity and around 1,600 jobs.
Stellantis committed €2.4 billion to the second phase of a European battery cell plant, adding 20 gigawatt-hours of annual capacity and around 1,600 direct jobs. Construction starts before year-end, with commissioning targeted for 2028.
The plant is operated through a joint venture. Company officials framed the expansion as a hedge against reliance on imported cells, which represent the largest input cost and strategic vulnerability in an EV.
Local unions welcomed the announcement while seeking clarity on wages and transfers from combustion-component operations. Stellantis does not plan further greenfield cell capacity in Europe beyond current projects.

text:
Peugeot e-3008 Opens European Order Books With Long-Range Variant
The fastback crossover launches with a claimed 435 miles of WLTP range in top specification.
By Thibault RenardMaleEurope44-59positive
Peugeot opened European order books for the e-3008, with the long-range single-motor variant claiming 435 miles of WLTP range. The fastback crossover is built at Sochaux on the STLA Medium architecture.
Three powertrains are offered: a 210hp single motor, the long-range version with a larger pack, and a 320hp dual-motor all-wheel-drive variant. All use an 800-volt architecture supporting charging above 150kW.
First deliveries are scheduled for September in France, Germany, Italy and Spain, with the UK in October. The 3008 nameplate is Stellantis' most important European product line by revenue.
